concepts.title: Purpose and path of a core assembly

body.text: The FHE moves new core assemblies from receipt through inspection and conditioning to the reactor vessel.
body.anchor: transfers new core assemblies from the point of receipt through inspection and conditioning

body.text: It keeps an assembly in an inert environment from the NAPS to the reactor, and from the reactor until the assembly is in the PIC and lowered into the SFP.
body.anchor: is designed to convey a core assembly in an inert environment

body.text: The shielded, inert transfer provides radiation shielding, radionuclide retention, and a medium for decay heat removal.
body.anchor: provides radiation shielding, radionuclide retention, and a medium for removal of decay heat

body.text: The EVHM is a rail-mounted, shielded, sealable vessel transport system.
body.anchor: is a rail-mounted, shielded, sealable, vessel transport system

body.text: The shielded cask assembly gives shielding and pressure boundary management, keeps an argon inert environment, and keeps fuel within design temperatures.
body.anchor: The shielded cask assembly has three primary functions

body.text: The EVHM grapple does not directly handle any reactor core assemblies. It handles the CAP.
body.anchor: The grapple does not directly handle any reactor core assemblies

body.text: Each CAP is filled with liquid sodium and acts as the heat sink and conduction path.
body.anchor: Each CAP is filled with liquid sodium and acts as the heat sink and conduction path

body.text: A passive siphon lowers the CAP sodium level as it leaves the sodium, to minimize spillage.

concepts.title: Cask cooling on loss of power

body.text: In EVHM cooling operations, exhaust blowers pull air through the annulus between the main shielding cask and the cold wall.
body.anchor: the exhaust blower fans continuously pull air through the annulus between the Main Shielding Cask and the cold wall

body.text: For heating, dampers shut and resistive heaters energize.
body.anchor: dampers contained within the air channels will shut and resistive heaters are energized

body.text: If the EVHM loses its plant side power, the dampers fail open and natural convection keeps cooling.
body.anchor: If the EVHM loses its plant side power connection, the dampers fail open

body.text: The EVHM passive heat removal system has a maximum heat capacity of 15.2 kW.
body.anchor: The EVHM passive heat removal system is designed with a maximum heat capacity of 15.2 kW

body.text: The EVHM passive system is designed for core assemblies 7 days after shutdown.
body.anchor: The EVHM passive cooling system is designed to handle core assemblies 7 days after shutdown

body.text: The BLTC handles assemblies only after a storage time in the EVST. It is designed for a 1.2 kW assembly.
body.anchor: The BLTC handles discharged core assemblies following a specified storage time in the EVST

body.text: The BLTC dampers also fail open on loss of plant power.
body.anchor: If the BLTC losses plant power the dampers fail open

body.text: The EVST is a sodium-filled tank with a rotating carousel and storage for 100 core assemblies in CAPs.
body.anchor: Storage positions are provided for 100 core assemblies within CAPs

body.text: The carousel holds assemblies in a subcritical array by geometry.
body.anchor: in an array with a subcritical configuration by geometry

body.text: The striker plate protects the EVST from accidentally dropped external loads.
body.anchor: The striker plate protects the EVST's functional and confinement capabilities

body.text: In a main vessel leak, the guard vessel captures sodium while main vessel level stays above the fueled portion of the assemblies.
body.anchor: the guard vessel captures the leaked liquid sodium while maintaining the sodium level in the main vessel above the fueled portion

body.text: The EVST is designed for a maximum decay heat of 216 kW and a normal decay heat of 136 kW.
body.anchor: The EVST is designed for a maximum decay heat load of 216 kW

body.text: Passive heat removal uses inlet and outlet stacks and ducts to circulate air through the EVST vault. Natural convection carries heat to the atmosphere, the ultimate heat sink.
body.anchor: utilizing inlet and outlet stacks and ducts to circulate air into and out of the EVST vault

body.text: Passive cooling keeps cladding below the maximum pin cladding temperature of 1157 F.
body.anchor: temperatures below the maximum pin cladding temperature of 1157 degrees Fahrenheit

body.text: Penetrations are above the minimum safe sodium level.
body.anchor: Penetrations on the EVST are above the minimum safe sodium level

body.text: A failure of the NST cooling and temperature control systems would not stop the SR passive heat removal function.
body.anchor: would not prevent the EVST from performing its SR passive heat removal function

body.text: Isolation valves on the main vessel close on detection of a leak or on loss of power.
body.anchor: equipped with isolation valves that close upon a detection of a leak or a loss of power

body.text: With little decay heat, trace heaters on the guard vessel and the sodium processing loop keep sodium temperature in limits.

title: Ex-Vessel Fuel Handling System
subject: FHE
intro: The FHE carries core assemblies between the reactor, the EVST, and the pool. Every step stays inert and shielded, and every carrier can cool fuel without power.
